title: Seedance2.5で生成した映像はほぼポン出しで使い、編集は音楽を付けてトランジションを1箇所だけ入れる程度に留めるとMVを素早く仕上げられる
content: Seedance2.5で生成した映像はほぼポン出しで使い、編集は音楽を付けてトランジションを1箇所だけ入れる程度に留めるとMVを素早く仕上げられる
tips: Seedance2.5で生成した映像はほぼポン出しで使い、編集は音楽を付けてトランジションを1箇所だけ入れる程度に留めるとMVを素早く仕上げられる

en.content:
If you use the footage generated with Seedance 2.5 almost as-is, and keep the editing to simply adding music and inserting just one transition, you can finish an MV quickly.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I meant to make an MV, but before I knew it, with 【H3】 it had turned into a full-on practice session for telop motion🔥

Produced by OiiOii 🎬
Just having the lyrics dance across the screen instantly turns it into a “work of art.”
I’m convinced that typography is a weapon.

It’s still very much a work in progress. I’ll study more and level up even further next time! 💪

The future is still a blank slate. There’s nothing but room to grow!
I’m sure of it 🤣

 #DirectorOnOii
@OiiOii @OiiOii_AI 
#OiiOiiCpp #OiiOii #AIANIMATION

El futuro aún está en blanco. ¡Solo hay margen de crecimiento!
